_comment: Ceiling floors re-measured 2026-10-10 under score.py SCORER_VERSION 4 with Prism v0.87.0 (grove v0.63.0: comments and strings are never read as code). Every case now scores recall 1.0 and precision 1.0, so every floor is 1.0; the production extras the 2026-09-12 baseline (Prism v0.74.0) carried (BeanDeserializerBase.handlePolymorphic, TransformedListIterator.add/set, the grafana extras) are gone. A run below baseline minus tolerance is a regression. ci_invariants refuses to compare different scorer versions.
